$comment: NORMATIVE ONLY for Stage A. No permission to implement evidence verifier/buckets/ranking.

coverage.scope: per source adapter and search run

rules.SEARCHED_OK: bounded live search completed within declared query scope; never means complete industry coverage
rules.PARTIAL: at least some results captured but pagination/time/filters incomplete; preserve reason
rules.SEARCH_ERROR: request failed (including exhausted 503) and no verified equivalent live fallback
rules.NOT_SEARCHED: source not queried in this run
rules.UNAVAILABLE: source is known unavailable or unsupported for requested scope; give reason

coverage.never_infer: no results != absent technology, absent market or negative expert label

SearchRun.notes: UUID run_id; query free text, NOT Excel signal name; scope text + explicit filters; as_of ISO-8601 timezone-aware optional; no future evidence; source coverage separate

SourceSearchResult.documents: array SourceDocument; empty on error is NOT successful empty search

SourceDocument.notes: source ID unique per run; timestamp formats ISO-8601 + timezone for retrieved_at; publication/event/public date unknown must be null, not now/indexed; hash snapshot bytes and track storage permissions

SourceSpan.notes: may prepare table but do not assert semantic validity or VERIFIED

TaskLog.notes: PASS_REVIEWED only on independent TEST artifact, not DEV claim

search_interface.input: search(query: str, scope: object, as_of: ISO8601|null, params: object, cursor: str|null) -> SourceSearchResult
search_interface.error_policy: bounded retry only; 403 auth error (no secret), 429/503 bounded backoff; terminal error SEARCH_ERROR or PARTIAL, never fixture fallback

storage.database: PostgreSQL; reversible first migration for search_runs, source_documents, source_spans (optional), task_log; later B entities only nullable placeholders if explicitly necessary
storage.snapshot: local filesystem for raw/redacted capture with checksum and access/retention note
storage.integrity: FK source.run_id->search_run.run_id, span.run_id/source_id match, unique IDs, no secrets, no real personal data

security.SEC-001: fake-key 403/503/timeout/connection failure tests before ANY live key; redact exception chain, request URL, log and snapshot
security.real_key_allowed: ONLY after independent TEST PASS of SEC-001 and env configuration outside repo
security.external_requests: respect source terms/rate limits; allowlisted HTTPS origins; no user secrets in documents
